exposure: Kaiser Permanente Neonatal Early-Onset Sepsis (EOS) Calculator (original version)
Kaiser Permanente Neonatal Early-Onset Sepsis (EOS) Calculator (updated version)
cohort: The study included 412,595 infants born at or after 35 weeks' gestation at 14 hospitals between January 2010 and December 2020.
finding: The updated EOS calculator demonstrated slightly higher sensitivity for identifying early-onset sepsis cases but led to a statistically significant increase in empirical antibiotic recommendations compared to the original model, with both remaining effective risk quantification tools.
